mapper.update: update ord_dis_delivery set receive_progress = #{receiveProgress},updater = #{updater},update_time = now() where id = #{disDeliveryOrderId} and delivery_status_code = #{deliveryStatusCode} and receive_progress = 2 and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_delete = 0

update ord_dis_delivery set receive_progress = #{receiveProgress},updater = #{updater},update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and delivery_status_code = #{deliveryStatusCode} and receive_progress = 1 and biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into ord_dis_delivery (delivery_order_no, delivery_status_code, source_code,stock_code, is_reversal_order, is_reversal, distribution_type, goods_type,sku_count, store_name, store_code, order_priority,order_quantity,order_amount, delivery_quantity, delivery_amount, distribution_quantity, distribution_amount, difference_order_no, request_order_no, hd_delivery_no, delivery_time, distribution_time, receive_time, receive_progress, auto_take_delivery_time, take_remark, org_code, biz_org_code, source_no, logistics_no, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete, remark, wrh_code) values
(#{item.deliveryOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.deliveryStatusCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sourceCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.stockCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.isReversalOrder,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{item.isReversal,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{item.distributionType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.goodsType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.skuCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.storeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.storeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.orderPriority,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.orderQuantity,jdbcType=DECIMAL} , #{item.orderAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{item.deliveryQuantity,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.deliveryAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.distributionQuantity,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.distributionAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.differenceOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.requestOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.hdDeliveryNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.deliveryTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.distributionTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.receiveTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.receiveProgress,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{item.autoTakeDeliveryTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.takeRemark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.sourceNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.logisticsNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.creator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updater,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.isDelete,jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.wrhCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: select stock_price from inv_stock_store where store_code=#{storeCode} and goods_code=#{goodsCode} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}
select stock_price from inv_stock_warehouse where warehouse_code=#{wrhCode} and stock_code=#{stockCode} and goods_code=#{goodsCode} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select oddr.id, oddr.store_code, oddr.order_type_config_id, oddr.order_cycle_id, oddr.request_order_no from ord_dis_deliv_request oddr inner join ord_dis_deliv_request_delivery oddrd on oddrd.request_order_id=oddr.id where oddrd.delivery_order_id=#{id} and oddr.biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select id, store_code, order_type_config_id, short_order_type, truncation_date_time, minimum_order_amount, org_code, biz_org_code, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete from ord_dis_order_cycle where id=#{orderCycleId} and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode}

select oddd.goods_code, sum(case when odd.delivery_status_code = 'shipped' then oddd.delivery_quantity else oddd.distribution_quantity end) as qty from ord_dis_delivery odd inner join ord_dis_delivery_detail oddd on odd.id = oddd.delivery_order_id and odd.is_delete = 0 where odd.store_code=#{storeCode} and odd.delivery_status_code in ('approved','previewApproved','shipped') and odd.create_time >= #{beginTime} and odd.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY oddd.goods_code

SELECT DISTINCT oddr.truncation_date_time, oddr.status_code FROM ord_dis_deliv_request oddr INNER JOIN ord_dis_deliv_request_detail oddrd ON oddrd.request_order_id = oddr.id AND oddrd.is_delete = 0 WHERE oddr.is_delete = 0 AND oddr.truncation_date_time >= #{startTime} AND oddr.truncation_date_time <= #{endTime} AND oddrd.distribution_type = #{distributionType} AND oddr.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode}

select count(1) from ord_dis_delivery d INNER JOIN ord_dis_deliv_request_delivery drd on drd.delivery_order_id = d.id INNER JOIN ord_dis_deliv_request r on r.id = drd.request_order_id where r.order_cycle_id = #{orderCycleId} and d.id != #{deliveryOrderId} and d.delivery_status_code != 'invalid' and d.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and d.is_delete = 0 and r.is_delete = 0

select count(1) from ord_dis_delivery d INNER JOIN ord_dis_order_first_delivery fd on fd.delivery_order_id = d.id where fd.first_order_id = #{firstOrderId} and d.id != #{deliveryOrderId} and d.delivery_status_code != 'invalid' and d.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and d.is_delete = 0

select id,delivery_order_no from ord_dis_delivery where store_code = #{storeCode} and is_reversal = 0 and is_reversal_order = 0 and delivery_status_code = 'received' and receive_time between #{minReceiveTime} and now() and is_delete = 0
